verdict.rationale: The 01 is an AI assistant platform that executes code and controls software, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no first-party versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Editable profiles in a source directory [gh-7] would at most let a user track changes with their own tools, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
